title: Dragon Sim, a free browser dragon breeder and fight sim
author: whyjay18
selftext:
I'm building 100 free browser games for my site: [randoms.games](http://randoms.games), and this week I spent most of my time on dragon sim. it's inspired by the facebook game dragon city, but the fights are real time instead of turn based, and the arena is a small voxel town that gets wrecked while the dragons fight.

There are 52 dragons, each with one signature power, and every one grows through 4 forms, so 208 designs in total. the last form is an ancient at level 30, and that's when the town really comes apart. breeding rolls genetics and whichever dragon matches is what hatches. there are 8 islands, one per league, each with its own crop and building. benched dragons can work jobs or go on expeditions. beat the champion and there's an endless ladder.

in fights you set the team, the order and a plan, then watch. your only input is swapping dragons mid fight (15 second cooldown) and 3 cheers (to boost ability cooldowns).

everything is three.js primitives, no art assets. claude code helped me make the dragon models and most of the features for this one, I used Fable 5.1 for modelling dragons in three.js from concepts. 

still beta and untested on real phones. [randoms.games](http://randoms.games), game 29.The progress is saved in your own browser cookies
